items.title: What’s Going On With MSCI (MSCI)?
items.summary: Recent Performance Snapshot MSCI (MSCI) has drawn fresh attention after a recent move in the share price, with the stock last closing at US$558.97 and mixed short term performance across the past week and month. For context, MSCI shares have seen short term momentum pick up with a 1-day share price return of 1.10%. However, the 90-day share price return is down 3.88% and the 1-year total shareholder return is slightly lower by 0.19%, suggesting interest is steady rather than surging. See how...

items.title: Turkey tightens hedge fund rules amid concerns over market manipulation
items.summary: Investing.com -- Turkey’s markets regulator tightened rules governing hedge funds on Saturday, introducing limits on concentrated investments and related-party exposure amid concerns over unusual market returns, Bloomberg reported.
